summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting routine monthly acquisitions of Partnership Shares and awards of Matching Shares under its Share Incentive Plan by PDMRs, including the CEO of Insurance, Pensions & Investments, the Chief Legal Officer, the Chief People and Places Officer, and the Chief Risk Officer. The transactions occurred on 9 July 2026 at a price of GBP 1.105 per share for partnership shares, with matching shares awarded at nil cost. There are no deal terms, special-situation catalysts, or strategic changes. This is an ordinary equity incentive disclosure with no impact on corporate control or structure.
